blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) official on Friday raised to the impeachment court her concern about the exposure of the names of their revenue officers in public after the defense team displayed confidential Letters of Authority (LOAs) on screen. Prosecution witness Anne Loraine Garcia-Marquez, chief-of-staff of the BIR Commissioner, brought up the issue after defense counsel Kristine Ferrer presented the LOAs issued to Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband, lawyer Manases Carpio, during cross-examination. Since Thursday, Garcia-Marquez reiterated that the contents of the LOAs cannot be disclosed to the public. While awaiting Ferrer to continue with […]...
